A 2x2 rect keeps the opposite edges exactly anti-parallel (2c is exactly representable), so the metamorphic `T(extrude(P)) = extrude(T(P))` is realized EXACTLY at f64 equality, as the packet requires. Same Rodrigues matrix on both sides.

The metamorphic fixture is a small box straddling the big box's TOP boundary (the resew convention) rather than a side face: the side-straddling pair is refused by the boolean's v1 envelope (UnsupportedEnvelope(ContactReductionDeferred)) at the base tree, so it cannot realize the metamorphic. The top-straddling pair's metamorphic vertex agreement is measured f64-exact (deviation 0).

The oblique wall's right cylinder is the bare cylinder at the ORIGIN with the profile radius, sheared by columns (x_hat, y_hat, sweep) with the bottom-cap circle center in w.
